t: You're standing in Hampstead Cemetery, in West Hampstead. It's open seven days a week, with closing times that change through the year. Several notable people are buried here. Joseph Lister is one, the surgeon who pioneered antiseptic surgery. Joseph Rotblat is another, the physicist who left the Manhattan Project on grounds of conscience in 1944. Tamara Karsavina, the Russian ballerina, settled in Hampstead and became one of the founders of modern British ballet. Also here are the economist William Stanley Jevons, Australian Prime Minister Andrew Fisher, and the Booker Prize-winning novelist Penelope Fitzgerald.
